cur-fossil-milodon.dateNote: In 1895 the settler Hermann Eberhard found a piece of skin, still with hair, in this cave in Chilean Patagonia. It came from Mylodon, a giant ground sloth. The bones and dung are Ice Age, about 0.013–0.01 million years old.
cur-fossil-milodon.summary: A Patagonian cave where the skin and dung of a giant ground sloth were found.

cur-fossil-cueva-fell.dateNote: In 1936–37 Junius Bird dug this cave near the Strait of Magellan, Chile. In its lowest layers he found "fishtail" spear points with the bones of extinct horses and ground sloths, left by people about 11,000 years ago (0.011 million years).
cur-fossil-cueva-fell.summary: A cave near the tip of South America where early hunters killed horses and sloths.
